text: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a boulder with opinions about where you're walking: Never stand next to it. Don't step next to it — it can't chase, so just walk around. Keep two squares away and it's furniture. When it seals up, wait it out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (You did the thing —

🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit BUSKER'S HARMONICA. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Busker's harmonica.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
★ IDENTIFIED: Egusi Melon. Vine, melon-sized fruits. The FRUIT is poison-bitter — the SEEDS are food, cooked. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Landlord: Never end on leased ground. Rent comes due every round you end on leased ground — keep moving and the ledger starves. Each ADDENDUM raises the rent and heals it. Never end two rounds on the same dirt. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Moderator: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
"CONTENT UNDER REVIEW." It draws a circle on the dirt — purple, the color of a bruise. It is reading everything you have ever done.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (Sigrun lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Reunion: Do something you have never done. It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
